exposure: Mode of conception (ICSI vs. naturally conceived)
cohort: 42 sex- and age-matched couples of ICSI-conceived children and naturally conceived controls
finding: Children born after ICSI had a distinct plasma proteomic profile compared to naturally conceived children, with overexpression of proteins implicated in acute-phase reaction, blood coagulation, complement pathway activation, and iron and lipid metabolism, suggesting a subclinical unfavorable cardiometabolic profile.
mod_finding: ICSI group had more cesarean sections compared to the naturally conceived group.
birth_weight: Smaller birth weight in the ICSI group
